'''Monarg's Mechanic Works''' was a dull gray prefabricated [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] dome in [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir's]] [[Dathomir Spaceport|preeminent spaceport]] owned by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Monarg]]. The building was a large hangar in which Monarg would house and repair [[Starship/Legends|starships]]; his efforts were aided by a legion of mechanic [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that he owned. There were doors on both ends of the shop that Monarg often kept open when cool winds blew from the continent's southern coasts, and the windows were situated four [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above the exterior ground. Monarg kept a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] console on a desk near one of the doors. In [[43 ABY]], Monarg housed the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[StarTripper]] [[Yacht/Legends|Yacht]] ''[[Bright Sun|She's a Chancer]]'' in his shop after purchasing it from the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]]; the shop was soon after infiltrated by the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. When one of R2-D2's masters, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]], arrived to rescue her droid, a [[Skirmish in the Dathomir spaceport|brief skirmish]] ensued within the shop that ultimately resulted in Solo, R2-D2, and the droid's counterpart [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] escaping. Shortly thereafter, the yacht was seized by the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport's]] deputy director of operations, [[Tarth Vames]], and given to the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] candidate [[Dyon Stadd]], who renamed it ''Bright Sun''.
